body:
Real audit found SKIN_TYLER/gband_mesh_rig is hardcoded to exactly 5 joints, not the general pipeline (checked its MAX_JOINTS assert directly). gband_skel_npc (the real general, arbitrary-joint-count path) was a single frozen demo -- now connected: story_ai NPCs render through it via new SKIN_MANNEQUIN, forced in MODE_STORY via the existing forced_skin mechanism, excluded from the player cosmetic menu. Real idle/walk switching added. Old static demo call removed (superseded). make server/lobby clean; Xvfb smoke-test showed no crash (this sandbox has no real GL driver, so shader output itself isn't visually verified, named honestly). Commit 86124cd + 4e8f850 + bd19b32.

⚓ ☃
title: Real, distinct AI-driven character rendering (SKIN_MANNEQUIN)
